decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The A3 use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times - 7am to 11pm.
Condition : 2 - No deliveries shall be taken at or dispatched from the site outside the hours of 9am to 11 pm nor at any time on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.
Condition : 3 - The external front podium area and forecourt shall not be used in conjunction with the hereby approved A3 use outside the following times 9am-9.30pm.

Condition : 4 - Use of the commercial unit shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials in respect of the commercial unit have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before the use is commenced.
description: Variation of condition 7 (opening times) to allow opening between 7am and 11pm of planning permission 00607/L/P2 dated  03/04/2013  for 'Reconfiguration and refurbishment of former magistrates court to provide restaurant/cafe at ground/lower ground floors, with creation of nine flats over upper and extended second floor levels. Provision of new ramp access to main entrance and new landscaped area to front.'
